commands.description: -- Clear excess copper.

help.main: Clear excess copper in polygons. Basically it's a negative Paint.
args: Name of the source Geometry object. String.

Diameter of the tool to be used. Can be a comma separated list of diameters.
WARNING: No space is allowed between tool diameters. E.g: correct: 0.5,1 / incorrect: 0.5, 1

Percentage of tool diameter to overlap current pass over previous pass. Float [0, 99.9999]
E.g: for a 25% from tool diameter overlap use -overlap 25

Can have the values: "no", "fwd" and "rev". String.It is useful when there are multiple tools in tooldia parameter."no" -> the order used is the one provided."fwd" -> tools are ordered from smallest to biggest."rev" -> tools are ordered from biggest to smallest.
Algorithm for copper clearing. Can be: "standard", "seed" or "lines".
Draw lines to minimize tool lifts. True (1) or False (0)
Cut around the perimeter of the painting. True (1) or False (0)
If used, the copper clearing will finish to a distance from copper features. Float number.
If used will copper clear the whole object. Either "-all" or "-box <value>" has to be used.
Name of the object to be used as reference. Either "-all" or "-box <value>" has to be used. String.
Name of the resulting Geometry object. String. No spaces.

help.main: Generates a Drill CNC Job from a Excellon Object.
args: Comma separated tool diameters of the drills to be drilled (example: 0.6,1.0 or 3.125). WARNING: No space allowed
Drill depth into material (example: -2.0). Negative value.
Progressive drilling into material with a specified step (example: 0.7). Positive value.
Drilling feed rate. It is the speed on the Z axis.
Speed of the spindle in rpm (example: 4000).

Z distance for toolchange (example: 30.0).
If used in the command then a toolchange event will be included in gcode
The X,Y coordinates at Toolchange event in format (x, y) (example: (30.0, 15.2) or without parenthesis like: 0.3,1.0). WARNING: no spaces allowed in the value.
The Z coordinate at job start (example: 30.0).
The Z coordinate at job end (example: 30.0).
The X,Y coordinates at job end in format (x, y) (example: (2.0, 1.2) or without parenthesislike: 0.3,1.0). WARNING: no spaces allowed in the value.

Time to pause to allow the spindle to reach the full speed.
If it is not used in command then it will not be included
This is the Excellon preprocessor name: case_sensitive, no_quotes

Name of move optimization type. B by default for Basic OR-Tools, M for Metaheuristic OR-ToolsT from Travelling Salesman Algorithm. B and M works only for 64bit version of FlatCAM and T works only for 32bit version of FlatCAM

Tolerance. Percentange (0.0 ... 100.0) within which dias in drilled_dias will be judged to be the same as the ones in the tools from the Excellon object. E.g: if in drill_dias we have a diameter with value 1.0, in the Excellon we have a tool with dia = 1.05 and we set a tolerance diatol = 5.0 then the drills with the dia = (0.95 ... 1.05) in Excellon will be processed. Float number.
It will not put errors in the Shell or status bar. Can be True (1) or False (0).
Name of the resulting Geometry object.
examples:
drillcncjob test.TXT -drillz -1.5 -travelz 14 -feedrate_z 222 -feedrate_rapid 456 -spindlespeed 777 -toolchangez 33 -endz 22 -pp default
Usage of -feedrate_rapid matter only when the preprocessor is using it, like -marlin-.
